description: Publishing platform for blogs and newsletters, in its development configuration.

promotion.reason: Withheld on 2026-09-10 although it qualified. The definition runs Ghost with NODE_ENV=development, which Ghost documents as unsuitable for anything but development, and it pins 5.130.6 when 6.x is current. Offering a development build to somebody who wants a blog would give them one that upstream will not support. Revisit with a production Ghost definition — caprover's ghost-only pins 6.44.0-alpine.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.

This definition sets NODE_ENV=development, which is Ghost's development mode: it keeps its content in a SQLite file, skips the production configuration Ghost expects, and is not what the project supports for a real site.
